mapper.select: SELECT id, enterprise_id, tenant_code, apply_no, version_no, applicant_id, company_name, industry, scale, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, license_no, register_address, legal_person, license_file_id, status, reviewer_id, review_time, reject_reason, submit_time, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM enterprise_review WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) + 1 FROM enterprise_review WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
